title_as_printed: Mole Fraction of Propane in Water, x1, at Given Temperatures and Pressures

footnotes_as_printed.a: H, Lw, and V refer to solid hydrate, liquid water, and vapor, respectively.

pressure_note: crystallizer pressure held constant during the experiment (kPa); the paper does not say gauge or absolute, or total or propane partial pressure

value.what: mole fraction of propane in the liquid water phase; mean of replicate experiments at each T, P condition; V-Lw rows are hydrate-free, H-Lw rows are liquid water in equilibrium with propane hydrate

row_regime_overrides.reason: region column H-Lw: liquid water in equilibrium with solid propane hydrate (above the three-phase line)

extra_unmapped: region (V-Lw vapour + liquid water, H-Lw hydrate + liquid water)
conversion_needs: value printed as 10^4 x1: multiply by 1e-4
notes: Temperatures 274.16 to 276.21 K. Row order as printed. Rows at 275.20 K with 302 and 352 kPa carry the same x1 (1.572), as printed.
